verdict.rationale: The evidence documents authentication via API key or OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine and IP whitelisting, but none of it mentions scoped, read-only, or permission-restricted credentials that could read analytics without send rights. IP allowlisting and generic auth methods are adjacent controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
